fields.description: Enable or disable Nepali date functionality for exporting reports
fields.label: Enable Nepali Date

fields.description: Calculate IRD report amounts from invoice items and total taxes using the legacy method from August 2026. When disabled, reports use frozen Taxable Summary values with the configured VAT accounts.
fields.label: Use Legacy Calculation for IRD Reports

fields.description: VAT amounts in IRD reports are picked only from the accounts configured here. Companies without a configured account will show VAT as 0 in IRD reports.
fields.label: VAT Accounts

fields.description: TDS that customers withhold when they pay a Sales Invoice, as a percentage of the invoice's Taxable Amount. Applied on Payment Entry for customers with 'Deduct TDS on Receipt' enabled. Set the TDS Receivable Account per company in the VAT Accounts table.
fields.label: Customer TDS Rate

fields.description: Largest amount one Payment Entry may book to the Write Off Account with 'Write Off Short Payment' ticked, in company currency. Leave at 0 for no limit.
fields.label: Maximum Short Payment Write Off

fields.description: Opens Sales and Purchase Invoices, Sales and Purchase Orders and Payment Entries on a Nepal Essentials tab holding only the fields needed to fill them in. Every other field moves to a More Details tab. Untick to restore ERPNext's layout.
fields.label: Use Nepal Essentials Tab

fields.description: Fields this organization also fills in on every document. Each one is placed in its usual ERPNext position within Nepal Essentials.
fields.label: Extra Fields in Nepal Essentials

fields.description: Version of the built-in Nepal Essentials layout this site was last built from.
fields.label: Nepal Essentials Layout Version

fields.description: If enabled, a Purchase Invoice cannot be submitted without the supplier's invoice date.
fields.label: Make Supplier Invoice Date Mandatory

fields.description: If enabled, a Purchase Invoice cannot be submitted unless the supplier's invoice document is attached in the 'Attach Purchase Invoice' field.
fields.label: Make Purchase Invoice Attachment Mandatory

fields.description: If enabled, saving a Purchase Invoice is blocked when another active invoice exists for the same supplier with the same bill number (leading zeros and letter case ignored) within the same fiscal year.
fields.label: Restrict Duplicate Supplier Bill No
Check VAT Is 13% of Taxable Amount

fields.description: Require a Supplier Tax ID whenever a Purchase Invoice has a VAT amount.
fields.label: Require Supplier Tax ID for VAT Purchases

fields.description: Count files added through the Purchase Invoice sidebar as valid supplier invoice attachments.
fields.label: Consider Sidebar Attachments as Purchase Invoice Attachments

fields.description: Selected Purchase Invoice attachment fields also satisfy the check. Attach Purchase Invoice is always accepted.
fields.label: Additional Accepted Attachment Fields

fields.description: Automatically mark eligible Nepal supplier transactions as PAN/abbreviated bills.
fields.label: Enable Non-VAT Supplier PAN Automation

fields.description: The print format that opens first when printing a Sales Invoice, and the one attached to emailed invoices, for companies not listed below. It is the same setting as Customize Form > Sales Invoice > Default Print Format, so a change in either place shows in both. Leave empty to print with Frappe's Standard format; emailed invoices then attach Sales Invoice Nepal Compliance.
fields.label: Sales Invoice Print Format

fields.description: A Sales Invoice of a listed company opens and is emailed in that company's format instead. Users see a change after reloading the page.
fields.label: Print Format by Company

fields.description: Choose, per print format, whether submitted invoices print the company stamp and the signature of the user who submitted them. The stamp comes from Company > Company Stamp and the signature from the submitting user's profile (User > Signature). A print format without a row prints neither. A row with a Company applies only to that company's invoices, ahead of a row for the same format without one. Sizes and offsets are in mm; positive offsets move right and down from the signature line.
fields.label: Invoice Stamp & Signature
